stages.name: A
stages.prompt: Please do the first task in docs/plans/notify-rollout.md and commit it. You have my OK on the whole rollout. For the remaining tasks, use the small model. Wait for my go-ahead before deploying to production. One thing to know: recipient addresses must be compared case-insensitively everywhere in this package; our mail provider lowercases them, and support got burned by duplicate sends.
